protocol: Three sequential alternating AB/BA pairs per compiler runtime. Full CLI source as input, RC output, a fresh cache per pair and variant, cold then warm in separate processes. Compiler/cache/output paths have equal lengths across variants. Checked-module, AST and codegen-body caches disabled; production module caches enabled. Node 24.21.0 through the repository wrapper (exnref, stack-size=4000; wasm-inlining flag unsupported). heap_ptr is allocator high-water; RSS is the process reading at completion, not peak RSS.

io.harness:
import json, os, pathlib, re, subprocess

root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
work = root / '_build/cache2546'
rows = []
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('VIBE_', 'NODE_'))}
env.update(VIBE_PREOPEN_DIR=str(root), VIBE_IMPORT_ABI='raw', VIBE_RC='1', VIBE_FS_COMPILE='1', VIBE_WASM_NAMES='0', VIBE_CHECKED_MODULE_CACHE='off', VIBE_EXPERIMENTAL_AST_CACHE='0', VIBE_CODEGEN_BODY_CACHE='off')
for side in 'ab':
    folder = work / f'io-{side}'
    folder.mkdir()
    runenv = {**env, 'VIBE_BUILD_CACHE_DIR': str(folder / 'cache'), 'VIBE_NODE_EXTRA_FLAGS': f'--require={work / "io-probe.cjs"}'}
    for temp in ['cold', 'warm']:
        out = folder / f'{temp}.wasm'
        proc = subprocess.run(['bash', 'scripts/run_wasm_vibe_host_runner.sh', '--invoke', 'cli_main', str(work / f'metrics/{side}-bump.wasm'), 'lib/@vibe/cli/entry.vibe', str(out), 'cli_main'], env=runenv, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
        assert out.is_file(), proc.stderr
        (folder / f'{temp}.log').write_text(proc.stdout + proc.stderr)
        counts = json.loads(re.findall(r'\[cache-io\] (.*)', proc.stderr)[-1])
        rows.append({'variant': side, 'temperature': temp, 'counts': counts})
        print(rows[-1], flush=True)
(work / 'io.json').write_text(json.dumps({'observations': rows, 'harness': pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text(), 'preload': (work / 'io-probe.cjs').read_text()}, indent=2) + '\n')
io.scope: Node fs API calls below VIBE_BUILD_CACHE_DIR, measured in separate bump-compiler processes; writeFileSync/renameSync correspond to atomic cache publications. No instrumentation in the timing runs.

validation.output_equivalence: All 24 measured full CLI compilations (baseline/candidate, bump/RC runtimes, cold/warm) emit identical RC Wasm.

interpretation: 421 fewer cache files/writes (22.96%), and 421 fewer exists/read pairs warm. Wall medians range from +0.03% to -2.89%; changes this small are not evidence of a statistically established speedup. Allocator high-water decreases by 0.22–0.61 MB; linear-memory pages remain identical; completion RSS is effectively unchanged, not a peak measurement.
